usual_baseline: Levels are taken irregularly and often at the wrong time. Mean interval 10 months 2 weeks, 32% above range [3114]. Only 12.9–56.3% of samples taken over 15 hours post dose [3279]. Levels rechecked after smoking change in 42.86% [3385]. Toxicity screening for levels >600 in 67% [3389].
fix_that_works: No audit in these records reports a re-audit. None can be cited as working.
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: All five audits are single cycles, so a closed loop would add something. Pick one specific trigger, such as a change in smoking status or a high level, and audit the response. Sample timing with bespoke dosing regimes is poorly covered by guidance and worth measuring.
